answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 213 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is written down against the onyx challenge, the thread audit can replay the orchard history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2220 identities would post 3671 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
